title: Refund policy
version: 1.0
---

## 2.1 Refund window
A payment can be refunded only within 14 days of the charge date. Older payments are denied.

## 2.2 Duplicate charge
Two succeeded payments of the same amount within 24 hours are a duplicate charge. Refund the second payment with reason double_charge.

## 2.3 Automatic limit and escalation
Refunds above 20.00 USD require a human. The server returns LIMIT_EXCEEDED and the agent escalates.
